title: The customer places an order
text: Checkout on the website sends the order, with the delivery address and items, to the shop's order system.

title: Payment is authorised
text: The shop asks the payment provider to reserve the amount on the customer's card. Nothing is charged until the order ships.

title: The warehouse picks and packs
text: The order appears on the warehouse pick list. Staff collect the items, pack them and print a shipping label.

title: The parcel goes to the carrier
text: The carrier scans the label at pickup, and the shop emails the customer a tracking link.

title: The parcel is delivered
text: The carrier delivers to the customer's door. The loop is closed and the payment is captured.
